title: Nominalizatsiya va akademik uslub
goal_uz: Dars oxirida og‘zaki uslubdagi xatboshini fe’llarni otga aylantirish, shaxssiz tuzilmalar va zich ot birikmalari yordamida akademik uslubga o‘tkaza olasiz hamda nominalizatsiyani qachon ishlatmaslik kerakligini aniqlay olasiz.

vocab.uz: nominalizatsiya, fe’l yoki sifatni otga aylantirish

scenes.title: Gapirishdan akademik yozuvga
board: Lesson: Nominalisation and academic style
(Nominalizatsiya va akademik uslub)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda abstrakt mavzularda og‘zaki fikr yuritishni o‘rgandik: tushunchani aniqlash, faraz qilish, ehtiyotkor umumlashtirish. Bugun o‘sha fikrlarni yozma akademik tilga o‘tkazamiz. Dars oxirida oddiy og‘zaki xatboshini nominalizatsiya, shaxssiz uslub va zich ot birikmalari bilan akademik matnga aylantira olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time you reasoned about abstract ideas out loud. Today we put those ideas on paper, in the style that universities and journals expect.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar mavhum g‘oyalar haqida ovoz chiqarib fikr yuritdingiz. Bugun bu g‘oyalarni universitetlar va jurnallar kutadigan uslubda qog‘ozga tushiramiz.

scenes.title: Nominalizatsiya nima?
board: Spoken: The government decided to cut taxes.
Academic: The government's decision to cut taxes ...
verb → noun = action becomes a concept

examples.t: The government's decision to cut taxes was widely criticised.
examples.uz: Hukumatning soliqlarni kamaytirish haqidagi qarori keng tanqid qilindi.

scenes.say_native: Nominalizatsiya bu fe’l yoki sifatni otga aylantirish. “The government decided” harakat haqida gapiradi. “The government’s decision” esa harakatni tushunchaga aylantiradi va endi u haqda yana nimadir aytish mumkin: qaror tanqid qilindi. Akademik matnda g‘oyalar jarayon va tushunchalar sifatida beriladi, shuning uchun bu usul juda ko‘p uchraydi.
scenes.say: The government decided to cut taxes. That is a story. The government's decision to cut taxes was widely criticised. Now the action has become a thing we can evaluate.
scenes.say_uz: Hukumat soliqlarni kamaytirishga qaror qildi. Bu hikoya. Hukumatning soliqlarni kamaytirish haqidagi qarori keng tanqid qilindi. Endi harakat baholash mumkin bo‘lgan narsaga aylandi.

scenes.title: Fe’ldan ot yasovchi qo‘shimchalar
board: -tion/-sion: reduce → reduction, decide → decision
-ment: develop → development
-ance/-ence: perform → performance, exist → existence
-al · -ure · -sis: approve → approval, fail → failure, analyse → analysis

examples.t: The failure of the scheme led to its withdrawal.
examples.uz: Sxemaning muvaffaqiyatsizligi uning bekor qilinishiga olib keldi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: fe’ldan otga o‘tish. Asosiy qo‘shimchalar: -tion va -sion, reduction, decision; -ment, development; -ance va -ence, performance, existence; -al, approval, refusal; -ure, failure; -sis, analysis. O‘zbekchada ko‘pincha “-ish” yoki “-lik” bilan yasaymiz: kamaytirish, rivojlanish. Inglizchada esa qo‘shimchani taxmin qilib bo‘lmaydi, har bir juftni yodlang.
scenes.say: Reduce becomes reduction, develop becomes development, perform becomes performance, approve becomes approval, fail becomes failure, and analyse becomes analysis.
scenes.say_uz: Reduce reduction ga, develop development ga, perform performance ga, approve approval ga, fail failure ga, analyse esa analysis ga aylanadi.

scenes.title: Sifatdan ot va noodatiy shakllar
board: able → ability · likely → likelihood · difficult → difficulty
grow → growth · lose → loss · choose → choice
prove → proof · believe → belief · respond → response

examples.t: The likelihood of success is low.
Economic growth slowed after the loss of key markets.
examples.uz: Asosiy bozorlar yo‘qotilgach, iqtisodiy o‘sish sekinlashdi.

scenes.say_native: Sifatlar ham otga aylanadi: able, ability; likely, likelihood; important, importance; difficult, difficulty. Ba’zi fe’llar esa noodatiy ot beradi: grow, growth; lose, loss; choose, choice; prove, proof; believe, belief; respond, response. Bu shakllarda imlo o‘zgaradi, shuning uchun yozishda ehtiyot bo‘ling: proof bilan prove, belief bilan believe farqli yoziladi.
scenes.say: The likelihood of success is low. Economic growth slowed after the loss of key markets. Notice the spelling changes: prove and proof, believe and belief, choose and choice.
scenes.say_uz: Muvaffaqiyat ehtimoli past. Asosiy bozorlar yo‘qotilgach, iqtisodiy o‘sish sekinlashdi. Imlo o‘zgarishiga e’tibor bering: prove va proof, believe va belief, choose va choice.

scenes.title: Bir xil shakl, boshqa urg‘u
board: noun ˈincrease — verb inˈcrease
noun ˈdecrease — verb deˈcrease
noun ˈrecord — verb reˈcord
decline · change · rise: no change

examples.t: Prices increased. → There was an increase in prices.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zi so‘zlar fe’l ham, ot ham bo‘ladi va qo‘shimcha olmaydi: increase, decrease, decline, change, rise. Talaffuzga e’tibor bering: increase va decrease otda birinchi bo‘g‘inga, fe’lda ikkinchi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u oladi. Record ham shunday. Decline, change va rise da urg‘u o‘zgarmaydi. Taqdimotda “an inCREASE” desangiz, quloqqa g‘alati eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Prices increased. There was an increase in prices. Listen: the noun is INcrease, the verb is inCREASE. The same with DEcrease and deCREASE, and with REcord and reCORD.
scenes.say_uz: Narxlar oshdi. Narxlarda o‘sish bo‘ldi. Tinglang: ot INcrease, fe’l inCREASE. DEcrease va deCREASE, REcord va reCORD ham shunday.

scenes.title: Noto‘g‘ri ot shakli
board: ✗ the analyse of the data → ✓ the analysis of the data
✗ the arrive of migrants → ✓ the arrival of migrants
✗ the develop of cities → ✓ the development of cities
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p xato: fe’lni o‘zgartirmasdan ot o‘rnida ishlatish. “The analyse of the data” emas, “the analysis of the data”. “The arrive” emas, “the arrival”. Analysis ning ko‘pligi analyses, bu ham ko‘p unutiladi. Yana bir eslatma: Britaniya inglizchasida analyse, emphasise, Amerikada analyze, emphasize deb yoziladi. Bitta matnda bitta variantni izchil ishlating.
scenes.say: The analysis of the data, not the analyse. The arrival of migrants, not the arrive. The development of cities, not the develop. And the plural of analysis is analyses.
scenes.say_uz: The analysis of the data, the analyse emas. The arrival of migrants, the arrive emas. The development of cities, the develop emas. Analysis ning ko‘pligi analyses.

scenes.title: Otga aylantiring
board: 1 refuse  2 grow  3 fail
4 likely  5 respond  6 emphasise
scenes.say_native: Oltita so‘z. Har birining ot shaklini ayting va iloji bo‘lsa, qisqa birikma tuzing, masalan “the refusal of the offer”. Qo‘shimchani taxmin qilmang, eslab ko‘ring: -al, -th, -ure, -hood, -se yoki -sis. Pauza qiling va javob bering. Imloga ham e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Give the noun form. One: refuse. Two: grow. Three: fail. Four: likely. Five: respond. Six: emphasise.
scenes.say_uz: Ot shaklini ayting. Bir: refuse. Ikki: grow. Uch: fail. To‘rt: likely. Besh: respond. Olti: emphasise.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 refusal  2 growth  3 failure
4 likelihood  5 response  6 emphasis
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Refusal, growth, failure, likelihood, response, emphasis. E’tibor bering: emphasis ning ko‘pligi emphases. Response da “respond” dagi d yo‘qoladi va “-se” bilan tugaydi. Likelihood, “ehtimollik”, ilmiy matnda probability ga qaraganda ko‘proq kundalik va umumiy ma’noda ishlatiladi. Hammasini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib.
scenes.say: Refusal, growth, failure, likelihood, response and emphasis. The likelihood of rain. A rapid response. Particular emphasis on safety.
scenes.say_uz: Refusal, growth, failure, likelihood, response va emphasis. Yomg‘ir ehtimoli. Tezkor javob. Xavfsizlikka alohida e’tibor.

scenes.title: Gapni qayta qurish
board: Prices rose sharply.
→ a sharp rise in prices
adverb → adjective · subject → in/of + noun

examples.t: Unemployment fell dramatically. → a dramatic fall in unemployment
examples.uz: Ishsizlik keskin kamaydi. → ishsizlikning keskin kamayishi

scenes.say_native: Nominalizatsiya faqat bitta so‘zni almashtirish emas, butun gapni qayta qurish. “Prices rose sharply” gapida fe’l rose otga aylanadi: a rise. Ravish sharply sifatga aylanadi: a sharp rise. Ega prices esa predlog bilan keyinga o‘tadi: in prices. Natijada bitta gap bitta ot birikmasiga aylanadi va uni boshqa gapga joylash mumkin.
scenes.say: Prices rose sharply becomes a sharp rise in prices. Unemployment fell dramatically becomes a dramatic fall in unemployment. The adverb turns into an adjective, and the subject moves after a preposition.
scenes.say_uz: Narxlar keskin oshdi gapi narxlarning keskin oshishiga aylanadi. Ishsizlik keskin kamaydi gapi ishsizlikning keskin kamayishiga aylanadi. Ravish sifatga aylanadi, ega esa predlogdan keyinga o‘tadi.

scenes.title: Ikki gapdan bitta
board: Because X happened, Y happened.
→ Noun X + lead to / result in + noun Y
contribute to · give rise to · stem from

examples.t: The rapid increase in unemployment led to a rise in crime.
examples.uz: Ishsizlikning tez o‘sishi jinoyatchilikning ko‘payishiga olib keldi.

examples.t: The decline in bee populations stems from pesticide use.
examples.uz: Asalarilar sonining kamayishi pestitsidlardan foydalanish bilan bog‘liq.

scenes.say_native: Nominalizatsiyaning asosiy kuchi: ikki voqea orasidagi sabab-oqibatni bitta gapda ifodalash. Og‘zaki: “because unemployment increased quickly, crime rose”. Akademik: “The rapid increase in unemployment led to a rise in crime.” Endi bog‘lovchi o‘rnida fe’l ishlaydi: lead to, result in, contribute to, give rise to, stem from. Esda tuting, stem from teskari yo‘nalishda: oqibat oldin, sabab keyin.
scenes.say: Because unemployment increased quickly, crime rose. In academic style: The rapid increase in unemployment led to a rise in crime. The decline in bee populations stems from pesticide use.
scenes.say_uz: Ishsizlik tez oshgani uchun jinoyatchilik ko‘paydi. Akademik uslubda: ishsizlikning tez o‘sishi jinoyatchilikning ko‘payishiga olib keldi. Asalarilar sonining kamayishi pestitsidlardan foydalanishdan kelib chiqadi.

scenes.title: Ot birikmasidagi predloglar
board: ✗ an increase of prices → ✓ an increase in prices
✓ an increase of 5% (amount)
✗ impact to → ✓ impact on · ✗ demand of → ✓ demand for
scenes.say_native: Predlog xatolari juda ko‘p. O‘sish va kamayish otlaridan keyin, nima o‘zgarganini aytsak, in keladi: an increase in prices, a fall in demand. Of esa miqdor uchun: an increase of five per cent. Impact va influence dan keyin on, demand va need dan keyin for, approach dan keyin to. O‘zbekcha qaratqich kelishigi sizni “of” ga undaydi, lekin bu yerda ko‘pincha noto‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: An increase in prices, but an increase of five per cent. The impact on health. The demand for housing. A new approach to teaching.
scenes.say_uz: Narxlardagi o‘sish, lekin besh foizlik o‘sish. Sog‘liqqa ta’sir. Uy-joyga talab. O‘qitishga yangi yondashuv.

scenes.title: Akademik qilib qayta yozing
board: 1 Exports fell slightly last year.
2 People use cars more, so the air is dirtier.
3 The council refused the plan, and residents were angry.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni nominalizatsiya bilan qayta yozing. Birinchisini bitta ot birikmasiga aylantiring. Ikkinchi va uchinchisida sabab-oqibatni lead to yoki result in kabi fe’l bilan bering. Pauza qiling, so‘ng gaplaringizni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Shoshilmang.
scenes.say: Rewrite using nominalisation. One: Exports fell slightly last year. Two: People use cars more, so the air is dirtier. Three: The council refused the plan, and residents were angry.
scenes.say_uz: Nominalizatsiya bilan qayta yozing. Bir: o‘tgan yili eksport biroz kamaydi. Ikki: odamlar mashinadan ko‘proq foydalanadi, shuning uchun havo iflosroq. Uch: kengash rejani rad etdi va aholi g‘azablandi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1 a slight fall in exports last year
2 Increased car use has resulted in poorer air quality.
3 The council's refusal of the plan provoked anger among residents.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchi: “a slight fall in exports last year”, butun gap bitta birikma. Ikkinchi: “Increased car use has resulted in poorer air quality.” Bu yerda “people” umuman yo‘qoldi, chunki akademik matnda jarayon muhim. Uchinchi: “The council’s refusal of the plan provoked anger among residents.” Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi fe’llar otga aylangan.
scenes.say: One: a slight fall in exports last year. Two: Increased car use has resulted in poorer air quality. Three: The council's refusal of the plan provoked anger among residents.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: o‘tgan yili eksportning biroz kamayishi. Ikki: mashinadan foydalanishning ko‘payishi havo sifatining yomonlashuviga olib keldi. Uch: kengashning rejani rad etishi aholi orasida g‘azab uyg‘otdi.

scenes.title: Shaxssiz uslub: it-gaplar
board: It is argued / suggested / widely believed that ...
It has been shown that ...
It is worth noting that ...

examples.t: It has been suggested that sleep affects memory.
examples.uz: Uyqu xotiraga ta’sir qilishi taxmin qilingan.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: shaxssiz akademik ohang. Ko‘p fanlarda “I think” yoki “you can see” o‘rniga shaxssiz tuzilma afzal ko‘riladi. It is argued that, it has been suggested that, it is widely believed that. Bu yerda it hech narsaga ishora qilmaydi, u shunchaki joy egallovchi. O‘zbekchadagi “… deb hisoblanadi”, “… taxmin qilinadi” kabi majhul shakllarga juda o‘xshaydi.
scenes.say: It has been suggested that sleep affects memory. It is widely believed that bilingual children think more flexibly. It is worth noting that the sample was small.
scenes.say_uz: Uyqu xotiraga ta’sir qiladi, degan taxmin bor. Ikki tilli bolalar moslashuvchanroq fikrlaydi, deb keng hisoblanadi. Shuni ta’kidlash joizki, tanlanma kichik edi.

scenes.title: Jonsiz ega va majhul nisbat
board: The data suggest ... · The findings indicate ...
This study examines ...
Samples were collected in May. (passive)

examples.t: The findings indicate a link between diet and mood.
examples.uz: Natijalar ovqatlanish va kayfiyat o‘rtasida bog‘liqlik borligini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Shaxssiz uslubning yana ikki vositasi. Birinchisi, jonsiz ega: “The findings indicate”, “This study examines”, “The data suggest”. Rasmiy matnda data ko‘pincha ko‘plikda ishlatiladi, lekin “the data suggests” ham keng tarqalgan. Ikkinchisi, majhul nisbat: “Samples were collected”, ya’ni kim yig‘gani muhim emas. Lekin har bir gapni passiv qilmang, bu ham og‘irlashtiradi.
scenes.say: The findings indicate a link between diet and mood. This study examines how teenagers use news apps. Samples were collected in May and analysed in June.
scenes.say_uz: Natijalar ovqatlanish va kayfiyat o‘rtasida bog‘liqlik borligini ko‘rsatadi. Ushbu tadqiqot o‘smirlar yangilik ilovalaridan qanday foydalanishini o‘rganadi. Namunalar mayda yig‘ildi va iyunda tahlil qilindi.

scenes.title: Rasmiy so‘z tanlovi
board: get → obtain · find out → establish
look into → investigate · go up → increase
a lot of → a considerable amount/number of
think about → consider

examples.t: Researchers investigated how the virus spreads.

scenes.say_native: So‘z tanlovi ham uslubni belgilaydi. Kundalik frazali fe’llar o‘rniga ko‘pincha bitta lotin kelib chiqishli fe’l ishlatiladi: get o‘rniga obtain, look into o‘rniga investigate, go up o‘rniga increase, find out o‘rniga establish. A lot of o‘rniga a considerable amount of, sanaladigan ot bilan a considerable number of. Frazali fe’llar taqiqlanmagan, faqat ularni o‘ylab tanlang.
scenes.say: Researchers investigated how the virus spreads. They obtained data from a considerable number of hospitals. In conversation we would say they looked into it and got data from a lot of hospitals.
scenes.say_uz: Tadqiqotchilar virus qanday tarqalishini tekshirdi. Ular ko‘plab kasalxonalardan ma’lumot oldi. Suhbatda esa ular buni o‘rganib chiqdi va ko‘p kasalxonadan ma’lumot oldi der edik.

scenes.title: Akademik matnda nimalardan qochamiz
board: ✗ contractions: don't, it's
✗ emotive words: huge, terrible, amazing
✗ vague: things, stuff, nice
✓ substantial · severe · factors

examples.t: The policy had a substantial impact on poverty.

scenes.say_native: Akademik matnda qochadigan narsalar: qisqartmalar, ya’ni don’t, it’s; hissiy so‘zlar, masalan huge, terrible, amazing; noaniq so‘zlar, things, stuff, nice. Ularning o‘rniga aniqroq so‘zlar: substantial, severe, considerable, factors, aspects. Ritorik savollardan ham qoching. Bu qoidalar akademik va rasmiy yozuv uchun, lekin xat yoki blogda bunday cheklov yo‘q.
scenes.say: The policy had a substantial impact on poverty, not a huge impact. The consequences were severe, not terrible. Several factors were involved, not several things.
scenes.say_uz: Siyosat qashshoqlikka salmoqli ta’sir ko‘rsatdi, huge emas. Oqibatlar jiddiy edi, terrible emas. Bir nechta omil ishtirok etdi, things emas.

scenes.title: Og‘zaki uslub akademik matnda
board: ✗ You can see that it's a big problem.
✓ This constitutes a significant problem.
✗ Things like age and income ...
✓ Factors such as age and income ...
scenes.say_native: Talabalar inshosida tez-tez uchraydigan holat. “You can see that it’s a big problem” gapida uchta muammo bor: you, qisqartma va noaniq big. Akademik variant: “This constitutes a significant problem” yoki “It is evident that this is a significant problem.” “Things like age and income” o‘rniga “factors such as age and income”. Bunday almashtirish matnni darhol rasmiylashtiradi.
scenes.say: Not: You can see that it's a big problem. Better: This constitutes a significant problem. Not: things like age and income. Better: factors such as age and income.
scenes.say_uz: Bu katta muammo ekanini ko‘rishingiz mumkin emas. Yaxshiroq: bu jiddiy muammo hisoblanadi. Yosh va daromad kabi narsalar emas. Yaxshiroq: yosh va daromad kabi omillar.

scenes.title: Rasmiylashtiring
board: 1 We looked into why lots of students drop out.
2 It's a really bad problem.
3 People think that sugar is the main thing.
scenes.say_native: Uchta og‘zaki gap. Har birini shaxssiz akademik uslubga o‘tkazing: frazali fe’lni almashtiring, qisqartma va hissiy so‘zlarni olib tashlang, kerak bo‘lsa it-gap yoki jonsiz ega ishlating. Pauza qiling va yozib oling. Keyin namunalar bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Make these sentences academic and impersonal. One: We looked into why lots of students drop out. Two: It's a really bad problem. Three: People think that sugar is the main thing.
scenes.say_uz: Bu gaplarni akademik va shaxssiz qiling. Bir: ko‘p talabalar nega o‘qishni tashlashini o‘rganib chiqdik. Ikki: bu juda yomon muammo. Uch: odamlar asosiy narsa shakar deb o‘ylaydi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1 This study investigates the reasons for student dropout.
2 This is a serious problem.
3 It is widely believed that sugar is the principal factor.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchi: “This study investigates the reasons for student dropout.” We yo‘qoldi, looked into investigates ga, why esa “the reasons for” ga aylandi, bu ham nominalizatsiya. Ikkinchi: “This is a serious problem” yoki “a significant problem”. Uchinchi: “It is widely believed that sugar is the principal factor.” Main thing o‘rniga principal factor.
scenes.say: One: This study investigates the reasons for student dropout. Two: This is a serious problem. Three: It is widely believed that sugar is the principal factor.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: ushbu tadqiqot talabalar o‘qishni tashlashi sabablarini o‘rganadi. Ikki: bu jiddiy muammo. Uch: shakar asosiy omil deb keng hisoblanadi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ilmiy rahbar bilan suhbat
board: Supervisor: Dr Hughes
Student: Malika
Topic: the first draft of a report
scenes.say_native: Endi tinglang. Ilmiy rahbar doktor Hyuz talaba Malika bilan hisobotining birinchi qoralamasini muhokama qilmoqda. U qaysi gaplarni tuzatishni so‘raydi va nima uchun? Diqqat bilan tinglang, keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz. Ikkala so‘zlovchi ham bugungi mavzuni amalda ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Hughes: Your ideas are good, Malika, but the style is too conversational. Malika: Which parts? Hughes: Here you write: we found out that people don't trust banks. Malika: So, the findings indicate a lack of trust in banks? Hughes: Exactly. And avoid huge. Say substantial. Malika: Should I remove every we? Hughes: Not necessarily. In this field, we is acceptable in the methods section. Just don't start every sentence with it.
scenes.say_uz: Hyuz: G‘oyalaringiz yaxshi, Malika, lekin uslub juda so‘zlashuvga yaqin. Malika: Qaysi qismlar? Hyuz: Mana bu yerda: odamlar banklarga ishonmasligini bilib oldik, deb yozibsiz. Malika: Demak, natijalar banklarga ishonch yetishmasligini ko‘rsatadi? Hyuz: Aynan. Va huge dan qoching. Substantial deng. Malika: Har bir we ni olib tashlashim kerakmi? Hyuz: Shart emas. Bu sohada metodlar bo‘limida we qabul qilinadi. Faqat har gapni u bilan boshlamang.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
board: 1 What is the main problem with the draft?
2 How does Malika rewrite the sentence about banks?
3 Is “we” forbidden? Where is it acceptable?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi, qoralamaning asosiy muammosi nima? Ikkinchi, Malika banklar haqidagi gapni qanday qayta yozadi? Uchinchi, “we” umuman taqiqlanganmi, qayerda u qabul qilinadi? Inglizcha, to‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni qayta tinglang.
scenes.say: One: What is the main problem with the draft? Two: How does Malika rewrite the sentence about banks? Three: Is we forbidden? Where is it acceptable?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: qoralamaning asosiy muammosi nima? Ikki: Malika banklar haqidagi gapni qanday qayta yozadi? Uch: we taqiqlanganmi? Qayerda qabul qilinadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Too conversational
2 The findings indicate a lack of trust in banks.
3 No — acceptable in the methods section
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: uslub juda so‘zlashuvga yaqin. Ikkinchi: “The findings indicate a lack of trust in banks” — jonsiz ega va nominalizatsiya: don’t trust o‘rniga a lack of trust. Uchinchi: we taqiqlanmagan, bu sohada metodlar bo‘limida qabul qilinadi. Bu muhim: shaxssiz uslub qat’iy qonun emas, fanga va jurnal talabiga bog‘liq.
scenes.say: One: the style is too conversational. Two: The findings indicate a lack of trust in banks. Three: we is not forbidden; in this field it is acceptable in the methods section.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: uslub juda so‘zlashuvga yaqin. Ikki: natijalar banklarga ishonch yetishmasligini ko‘rsatadi. Uch: we taqiqlanmagan; bu sohada metodlar bo‘limida qabul qilinadi.

scenes.title: Ot birikmasining tuzilishi
board: pre-modifiers + HEAD + post-modifiers
the rapid GROWTH of online retail in rural areas
det + adj + noun · prep phrase · clause

examples.t: the rapid growth of online retail in rural areas
examples.uz: qishloq hududlarida onlayn savdoning tez o‘sishi

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: zich ot birikmalari. Har bir birikmaning markazi bor, uni bosh ot deymiz. Undan oldin aniqlovchilar keladi: artikl, sifat, ot. Undan keyin esa predlogli ibora yoki gap keladi. “The rapid growth of online retail in rural areas” birikmasida bosh ot growth. O‘zbekchada hamma aniqlovchi oldinda: “qishloq hududlarida onlayn savdoning tez o‘sishi”. Inglizchada ular ikki tomonga bo‘linadi.
scenes.say: The rapid growth of online retail in rural areas. The head noun is growth. Before it: the rapid. After it: of online retail, in rural areas. English splits modifiers on both sides of the head.
scenes.say_uz: Qishloq hududlarida onlayn savdoning tez o‘sishi. Bosh ot growth. Undan oldin: the rapid. Undan keyin: of online retail, in rural areas. Ingliz tili aniqlovchilarni bosh otning ikki tomoniga bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Ot + ot birikmalari
board: energy consumption = consumption of energy
data protection law
student housing shortage → read right to left

examples.t: There is a serious student housing shortage in the capital.
examples.uz: Poytaxtda talabalar uchun uy-joy tanqisligi jiddiy.

scenes.say_native: Akademik matnda otlar ko‘pincha yonma-yon keladi: energy consumption, data protection law. Birinchi ot sifat kabi ishlaydi va odatda birlikda turadi: a car factory, cars factory emas. Uzun birikmani o‘ngdan chapga o‘qing: student housing shortage, ya’ni tanqislik, nimaning? uy-joyning, kim uchun? talabalar uchun. Bu tartib o‘zbek tiliga yaqin, shuning uchun sizga tushunarli.
scenes.say: Energy consumption means the consumption of energy. A student housing shortage is a shortage of housing for students. Read long noun compounds from right to left.
scenes.say_uz: Energy consumption energiya iste’moli demakdir. Student housing shortage talabalar uchun uy-joy tanqisligi. Uzun ot birikmalarini o‘ngdan chapga o‘qing.

scenes.title: Keyingi aniqlovchilar
board: the measures introduced in 2020 (past participle)
students living abroad (-ing)
the decision to cut funding (to-infinitive)

examples.t: The measures introduced in 2020 reduced emissions.
Students living abroad often feel isolated.
examples.uz: Chet elda yashayotgan talabalar ko‘pincha yolg‘izlikni his qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Bosh otdan keyin qisqartirilgan nisbiy gaplar keladi va matnni ixcham qiladi. “The measures which were introduced in 2020” o‘rniga “the measures introduced in 2020”. “Students who live abroad” o‘rniga “students living abroad”. Ba’zi otlardan keyin to-infinitiv: the decision to cut funding, the attempt to reform. O‘zbekchada bular “joriy etilgan choralar” kabi oldinda turadi.
scenes.say: The measures introduced in 2020 reduced emissions. Students living abroad often feel isolated. The decision to cut funding was reversed. Each one is a relative clause made shorter.
scenes.say_uz: 2020-yilda joriy etilgan choralar chiqindilarni kamaytirdi. Chet elda yashayotgan talabalar ko‘pincha yolg‘izlikni his qiladi. Mablag‘ni qisqartirish haqidagi qaror bekor qilindi. Har biri qisqartirilgan nisbiy gap.

scenes.title: Birikmani bosqichma-bosqich quramiz
board: growth
→ sustained economic growth
→ sustained economic growth in developing countries
→ ... over the past two decades
scenes.say_native: Birikmani bosqichma-bosqich quraylik. Boshida bitta ot: growth. Oldiga aniqlovchilar qo‘shamiz: sustained economic growth, barqaror iqtisodiy o‘sish. Keyin orqasiga: in developing countries. Yana: over the past two decades. Endi bu birikma gapning egasi bo‘lishi mumkin: “Sustained economic growth in developing countries over the past two decades has reduced poverty.” Bitta gapda butun xatboshi g‘oyasi.
scenes.say: Growth. Sustained economic growth. Sustained economic growth in developing countries over the past two decades. Now use it as a subject: it has reduced extreme poverty.
scenes.say_uz: O‘sish. Barqaror iqtisodiy o‘sish. So‘nggi yigirma yil davomida rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlardagi barqaror iqtisodiy o‘sish. Endi uni ega sifatida ishlating: u o‘ta qashshoqlikni kamaytirdi.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha tartibdan kelgan xatolar
board: ✗ the in developing countries growth
✓ growth in developing countries
✗ the decision of cutting funding → ✓ the decision to cut funding
✗ informations, researches → ✓ information, research
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida hamma aniqlovchi otdan oldin keladi, shuning uchun “the in developing countries growth” kabi tartib paydo bo‘ladi. Predlogli ibora doim otdan keyin. Ikkinchi xato: decision of cutting. Decision, attempt, ability dan keyin to-infinitiv keladi. Uchinchi xato: information va research sanalmaydi, ularga s qo‘shilmaydi: a piece of research, much information.
scenes.say: Growth in developing countries, never the in developing countries growth. The decision to cut funding, not of cutting. And information and research are uncountable: no s.
scenes.say_uz: Rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlardagi o‘sish, prepozitsion ibora otdan keyin. The decision to cut funding, of cutting emas. Information va research sanalmaydi: s qo‘shilmaydi.

scenes.title: Bitta birikmaga jamlang
board: 1 Water is used. Farms use it. It is in Central Asia.
2 Young people are unemployed. It rose. It was rapid.
3 Companies decided. They moved jobs abroad.
scenes.say_native: Har bir qatordagi qisqa gaplarni bitta zich ot birikmasiga jamlang. Bosh otni toping, aniqlovchilarni uning oldiga yoki orqasiga joylang, predloglarga e’tibor bering. Gap emas, faqat birikma kerak. Pauza qiling va ayting. Keyin javoblar bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Combine each line into one noun phrase. One: Water is used. Farms use it. It is in Central Asia. Two: Young people are unemployed. It rose. It was rapid. Three: Companies decided. They moved jobs abroad.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir qatorni bitta ot birikmasiga birlashtiring. Bir: suv ishlatiladi. Fermalar uni ishlatadi. Bu Markaziy Osiyoda. Ikki: yoshlar ishsiz. U oshdi. Tez oshdi. Uch: kompaniyalar qaror qildi. Ular ish o‘rinlarini chet elga ko‘chirdi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 agricultural water use in Central Asia
2 the rapid rise in youth unemployment
3 companies' decision to move jobs abroad
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “agricultural water use in Central Asia” yoki “water use by farms in Central Asia”. Ikkinchi: “the rapid rise in youth unemployment”; young people unemployed birikmasi youth unemployment ga aylandi. Uchinchi: “companies’ decision to move jobs abroad” yoki “the decision by companies to move jobs abroad”. To-infinitivga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: One: agricultural water use in Central Asia. Two: the rapid rise in youth unemployment. Three: companies' decision to move jobs abroad.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Markaziy Osiyoda qishloq xo‘jaligida suvdan foydalanish. Ikki: yoshlar ishsizligining tez o‘sishi. Uch: kompaniyalarning ish o‘rinlarini chet elga ko‘chirish haqidagi qarori.

scenes.title: Tinglash: hisobotni tahrirlash
board: Colleagues: Ruth and Javlon
Document: a policy report
Problem: one very long sentence
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Hamkasblar Rut va Javlon siyosiy hisobotni tahrirlayapti. Javlon nominalizatsiyani juda yaxshi o‘rgangan, hatto haddan oshirib yuborgan. Rut qanday muammoni topadi va qanday yechim taklif qiladi? Tinglang. Bu bugungi oxirgi nuqtaga ko‘prik bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Ruth: Javlon, what does this sentence mean? The implementation of the reduction of administrative costs led to an improvement in the delivery of services. Javlon: It sounds academic, doesn't it? Ruth: It sounds like fog. Who reduced the costs? Javlon: The ministry. Ruth: Then say so. The ministry cut administrative costs, which improved services. Javlon: Shorter and clearer. Ruth: Keep one or two nouns, not five in a chain.
scenes.say_uz: Rut: Javlon, bu gap nimani anglatadi? Ma’muriy xarajatlarni qisqartirishni amalga oshirish xizmatlar ko‘rsatishning yaxshilanishiga olib keldi. Javlon: Akademik eshitiladi, to‘g‘rimi? Rut: Tuman kabi eshitiladi. Xarajatlarni kim qisqartirdi? Javlon: Vazirlik. Rut: Unda shuni ayting. Vazirlik ma’muriy xarajatlarni qisqartirdi va bu xizmatlarni yaxshiladi. Javlon: Qisqaroq va aniqroq. Rut: Zanjirda beshta ot emas, bitta-ikkita qoldiring.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
board: 1 What does Ruth compare the sentence to?
2 What information is missing from it?
3 What is Ruth's general advice?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi, Rut Javlonning gapini nimaga o‘xshatadi? Ikkinchi, gapda qaysi muhim ma’lumot yo‘q? Uchinchi, Rutning umumiy maslahati nima? Inglizcha, to‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Shoshilmang, kerak bo‘lsa qayta tinglang. Shoshilmang.
scenes.say: One: What does Ruth compare the sentence to? Two: What information is missing from it? Three: What is Ruth's general advice?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Rut gapni nimaga o‘xshatadi? Ikki: gapda qaysi ma’lumot yo‘q? Uch: Rutning umumiy maslahati nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Fog
2 Who did it — the agent (the ministry)
3 One or two nouns, not five in a chain
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Rut gapni tumanga o‘xshatadi, ya’ni hech narsa ko‘rinmaydi. Ikkinchi: harakatni kim bajargani, ya’ni vazirlik, yo‘q. Ingliz tilida buni agent deyishadi. Uchinchi: zanjirda beshta ot emas, bitta-ikkitasini qoldiring. Bu darsning to‘rtinchi nuqtasiga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri olib keladi: nominalizatsiyani qachon ishlatmaslik kerak.
scenes.say: One: fog. Two: the agent, the ministry, is missing. Three: keep one or two nouns, not five in a chain.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: tuman. Ikki: bajaruvchi, ya’ni vazirlik, yo‘q. Uch: zanjirda beshta ot emas, bitta-ikkitasini qoldiring.

scenes.title: Ortiqcha nominalizatsiya xavfi
board: Hides WHO did WHAT
Chains of “the X of the Y of the Z”
Smothered verbs: make a decision → decide
carry out an investigation → investigate

examples.t: The committee made a decision to carry out a review. → The committee decided to review ...
examples.uz: Qo‘mita ko‘rib chiqish o‘tkazishga qaror qabul qildi. → Qo‘mita ko‘rib chiqishga qaror qildi.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: qachon ishlatmaslik kerak. Ortiqcha nominalizatsiyaning uch belgisi bor. Birinchi, kim nima qilgani yashirinadi. Ikkinchi, “the X of the Y of the Z” zanjiri paydo bo‘ladi. Uchinchi, “bo‘g‘ilgan fe’llar”: make a decision o‘rniga decide, carry out an investigation o‘rniga investigate yetarli. O‘zbek rasmiy tilida ham “qaror qabul qilindi” kabi og‘ir iboralar ko‘p, ularni inglizchaga ko‘chirmang.
scenes.say: The committee made a decision to carry out a review of the policy. Better: The committee decided to review the policy. When a strong verb is available, let it do the work.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘mita siyosatni ko‘rib chiqishni amalga oshirishga qaror qabul qildi. Yaxshiroq: qo‘mita siyosatni ko‘rib chiqishga qaror qildi. Kuchli fe’l bo‘lsa, ishni o‘sha bajarsin.

scenes.title: Muvozanat qoidalari
board: Keep the agent when it matters
Max 3 nouns in a chain
Nouns for concepts, verbs for actions
Know your reader
scenes.say_native: Muvozanat uchun to‘rt qoida. Birinchi: agar kim qilgani muhim bo‘lsa, agentni saqlang. Ikkinchi: zanjirda uchtadan ortiq ot bo‘lmasin. Uchinchi: tushunchalar uchun ot, aniq harakatlar uchun fe’l. To‘rtinchi: o‘quvchingizni biling. Ilmiy maqola uchun zichlik yaxshi, ammo ko‘rsatma, xat yoki keng ommaga mo‘ljallangan matnda oddiy fe’llar ancha samarali.
scenes.say: Keep the agent when it matters. Avoid chains of more than three nouns. Use nouns for concepts and verbs for actions. And always ask who will read the text.
scenes.say_uz: Muhim bo‘lsa, bajaruvchini saqlang. Uchtadan ortiq ot zanjiridan qoching. Tushunchalar uchun ot, harakatlar uchun fe’l ishlating. Va har doim matnni kim o‘qishini so‘rang.

scenes.title: Haddan oshgan zichlik
board: ✗ The conduct of an examination of the reasons for the failure of the project was undertaken.
✓ We examined why the project failed.
scenes.say_native: Mana haddan oshgan nominalizatsiyaning klassik namunasi. Gapda beshta ot va to‘rtta of bor, lekin asosiy fe’l “was undertaken” hech narsa demaydi. Ma’nosi oddiy: “We examined why the project failed.” Yoki shaxssiz: “The reasons for the project’s failure were examined.” Akademik uslub murakkab bo‘lish degani emas, u aniq va tejamkor bo‘lish degani.
scenes.say: The conduct of an examination of the reasons for the failure of the project was undertaken. That is unreadable. We examined why the project failed. Or: The reasons for the project's failure were examined.
scenes.say_uz: Loyihaning muvaffaqiyatsizligi sabablarini tekshirishni o‘tkazish amalga oshirildi. Bu o‘qib bo‘lmaydi. Loyiha nega muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘lganini tekshirdik. Yoki: loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizligining sabablari tekshirildi.

scenes.title: Fe’lni qaytaring
board: 1 The company made an announcement of a reduction in staff.
2 An investigation was carried out by the police into the theft.
3 The provision of support to students is the responsibility of tutors.
scenes.say_native: Endi teskari ish. Uchta og‘ir gapni aniqroq qiling: bo‘g‘ilgan fe’llarni toping va ularni kuchli fe’lga aylantiring, agentni oldinga chiqaring. Hammasini olib tashlash shart emas, bitta tushuncha ot bo‘lib qolishi mumkin. Pauza qiling. Keyin namunalar bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Make these sentences clearer. One: The company made an announcement of a reduction in staff. Two: An investigation was carried out by the police into the theft. Three: The provision of support to students is the responsibility of tutors.
scenes.say_uz: Bu gaplarni aniqroq qiling. Bir: kompaniya xodimlarni qisqartirish haqida e’lon qildi. Ikki: politsiya tomonidan o‘g‘irlik bo‘yicha tergov o‘tkazildi. Uch: talabalarga yordam ko‘rsatish ustozlarning mas’uliyatidir.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1 The company announced staff cuts.
2 The police investigated the theft.
3 Tutors are responsible for supporting students.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchi: “The company announced staff cuts” yoki “announced that it would reduce staff”. Ikkinchi: “The police investigated the theft” — passiv va bo‘g‘ilgan fe’l yo‘qoldi. Uchinchi: “Tutors are responsible for supporting students.” Uchala gap ham qisqardi, lekin rasmiyligini yo‘qotmadi. Demak, rasmiylik faqat otlarga bog‘liq emas.
scenes.say: One: The company announced staff cuts. Two: The police investigated the theft. Three: Tutors are responsible for supporting students. Shorter, clearer, and still formal.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: kompaniya xodimlarni qisqartirishni e’lon qildi. Ikki: politsiya o‘g‘irlikni tergov qildi. Uch: ustozlar talabalarni qo‘llab-quvvatlash uchun mas’ul. Qisqaroq, aniqroq va baribir rasmiy.

scenes.title: Og‘zakidan akademikka: to‘liq namuna
board: Spoken: Loads of people moved to cities, so houses got really expensive.
Academic: Large-scale migration to cities has led to a sharp rise in housing costs.

examples.t: Large-scale migration to cities has led to a sharp rise in housing costs.
examples.uz: Shaharlarga keng ko‘lamli ko‘chish uy-joy narxlarining keskin oshishiga olib keldi.

scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasiga tayyorgarlik. Og‘zaki gap: “Loads of people moved to cities, so houses got really expensive.” Akademik variant: “Large-scale migration to cities has led to a sharp rise in housing costs.” Nimalar o‘zgardi? Loads of people moved migration ga aylandi, so o‘rniga has led to, got really expensive esa a sharp rise in housing costs bo‘ldi. Bugungi uch vosita bitta gapda.
scenes.say: Loads of people moved to cities, so houses got really expensive. In academic style: Large-scale migration to cities has led to a sharp rise in housing costs. Same idea, different register.
scenes.say_uz: Juda ko‘p odam shaharlarga ko‘chdi, shuning uchun uylar juda qimmatlashdi. Akademik uslubda: shaharlarga keng ko‘lamli ko‘chish uy-joy narxlarining keskin oshishiga olib keldi. G‘oya bir xil, uslub boshqa.

scenes.title: Yakuniy yozma vazifa
board: Kids spend loads of time on phones now.
Lots of teachers think they can't focus.
So schools are starting to ban them.
→ 2 academic sentences
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Doskadagi uchta og‘zaki gapni ikki akademik gapga aylantiring. Kamida ikkita nominalizatsiya, bitta shaxssiz tuzilma va bitta sabab-oqibat fe’li bo‘lsin. Lekin zanjirlardan qoching. Pauza qiling va yozing. Shoshilmang, aniqlik muhim.
scenes.say: Final task. Kids spend loads of time on phones now. Lots of teachers think they can't focus. So schools are starting to ban them. Rewrite this as two academic sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Bolalar hozir telefonda juda ko‘p vaqt o‘tkazadi. Ko‘p o‘qituvchilar ular diqqatini jamlay olmaydi deb o‘ylaydi. Shuning uchun maktablar ularni taqiqlashni boshlamoqda. Buni ikki akademik gapga aylantiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Children's increasing screen time has raised concerns among teachers about their ability to concentrate.
Consequently, a growing number of schools have introduced restrictions on phone use.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “Children’s increasing screen time has raised concerns among teachers about their ability to concentrate. Consequently, a growing number of schools have introduced restrictions on phone use.” Nominalizatsiyalar: screen time, concerns, ability, restrictions, use. Sabab-oqibat: has raised va consequently. Lekin gap o‘qiladi, zanjir yo‘q. Sizda ham shunday muvozanat bormi?
scenes.say: Children's increasing screen time has raised concerns among teachers about their ability to concentrate. Consequently, a growing number of schools have introduced restrictions on phone use.
scenes.say_uz: Bolalarning ekran oldida o‘tkazadigan vaqti ortib borayotgani o‘qituvchilarda ularning diqqatni jamlash qobiliyati haqida xavotir uyg‘otdi. Natijada tobora ko‘proq maktablar telefondan foydalanishga cheklovlar kiritdi.

scenes.title: Darsning xulosasi
board: verb/adj → noun: reduction, growth, likelihood
Impersonal: it is argued that · the findings indicate
Dense NP: pre + HEAD + post
Balance: keep agents, avoid noun chains
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: fe’l va sifatlarni otga aylantiring va gapni qayta quring: a sharp rise in prices. Ikkinchi: shaxssiz ohang uchun it-gaplar, jonsiz ega, rasmiy so‘zlar. Uchinchi: zich ot birikmasi bosh ot atrofida quriladi, predlogli ibora doim keyin. To‘rtinchi: agentni yashirmang, zanjirlardan qoching, kuchli fe’lni saqlang.
scenes.say: To sum up: turn actions into concepts, write impersonally, build dense but readable noun phrases, and never let nominalisation hide who did what.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: harakatlarni tushunchalarga aylantiring, shaxssiz yozing, zich lekin o‘qiladigan ot birikmalari tuzing va nominalizatsiya kim nima qilganini yashirishiga yo‘l qo‘ymang.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: rewrite a spoken paragraph in academic style
Success: ≥5 nominalisations, ≥2 impersonal structures, no chain of 4+ nouns
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz gapirgandek, so‘zlashuv uslubida 100–120 so‘zli xatboshi yozing yoki oldingi darsdagi nutqingizdan foydalaning. Keyin uni akademik uslubga o‘tkazing. Mezon: kamida beshta nominalizatsiya, kamida ikkita shaxssiz tuzilma, qisqartma va hissiy so‘zlar yo‘q, to‘rt va undan ortiq ot zanjiri yo‘q. Keyingi darsda kogeziya, ya’ni bog‘lovchi vositalarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: take a spoken paragraph of about a hundred words and rewrite it in academic style. Use at least five nominalisations and two impersonal structures, and avoid long noun chains. Next time: cohesion.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: taxminan yuz so‘zli og‘zaki xatboshini olib, akademik uslubda qayta yozing. Kamida beshta nominalizatsiya va ikkita shaxssiz tuzilma ishlating, uzun ot zanjirlaridan qoching. Keyingi safar: kogeziya.

homework_uz: So‘zlashuv uslubidagi 100–120 so‘zli xatboshi yozing (yoki oldingi darsdagi nutqingizdan foydalaning) va uni akademik uslubda qayta yozing. Mezon: kamida 5 ta nominalizatsiya, kamida 2 ta shaxssiz tuzilma (it is argued that, the findings indicate va h.k.), qisqartmalar va hissiy so‘zlar yo‘q, to‘rt va undan ortiq ot zanjiri yo‘q, kim nima qilgani tushunarli qolsin.

quiz.q: What is the noun form of “grow”?
Prices rose sharply. → There was a sharp rise ___ prices.
quiz.why_uz: Nima o‘zgargani in bilan: a rise in prices. Of miqdor uchun: a rise of 5%.

quiz.q: In the noun “increase”, where is the stress?
Which sentence is most appropriate for an academic report?
options: You can see that it's a huge problem.
It's really bad, to be honest.
Things are getting worse and worse.
quiz.why_uz: Shaxssiz, qisqartmasiz va aniq so‘z: significant.

quiz.q: Choose the formal equivalent of “look into”.
quiz.why_uz: Akademik matnda look into o‘rniga investigate.

options: the growth of in rural areas
quiz.why_uz: Predlogli ibora bosh otdan keyin keladi.

quiz.q: The government's decision ___ funding was criticised.
Which is a “smothered verb” that can be replaced by one verb?

options: The conduct of an examination of the causes was undertaken.
An examination of the causes was conducted by us.
The causes underwent the examination process.
quiz.why_uz: Ortiqcha nominalizatsiya agentni yashiradi va gapni og‘irlashtiradi.
